title: When Students Fail to Learn from Teachers: Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique for post-training large language models, enabling students to learn from dense token-level supervision on their own generations. However, even with a capable teacher, OPD training can be unstable, leading to excessive response length, repetitive generation, and severe performance degradation. One example is \textit{spurious agreement}, where the student maintains high overlap with the teacher at the states visited but produces repetitive generations. Although such failures have been observed, the mechanisms behind these failures remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we investigate OPD through the lens of learning dynamics, tracing three mechanisms from local analysis to subsequent on-policy sampling. We first identify states where sampled-token OPD updates fail to correct teacher--student mismatch and characterize them using the student's mass on the teacher's top-$p$ set.

translated_title: 当学生无法从教师处学习时：在线策略蒸馏的学习动力学
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为大语言模型后训练的核心技术，使学生模型能够在自身生成的序列上从密集的词元级监督中学习。然而，即使教师模型能力强大，OPD训练仍可能不稳定，导致响应过长、重复生成以及严重的性能退化。其中一个例子是“虚假一致性”（spurious agreement），即学生模型在所访问的状态上与教师模型保持高度重叠，但生成的结果却是重复的。尽管此类失败现象已被观察到，但其背后的机制仍鲜为人知。为弥补这一空白，我们从学习动力学的视角研究OPD，从局部分析追踪到后续在线策略采样的三种机制。我们首先识别出采样词元的OPD更新无法纠正教师-学生失配的状态，并利用学生在教师模型top-p集合上的概率质量来刻画这些状态。
tldr: 该论文从学习动力学视角揭示了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）训练不稳定（如重复生成、响应过长）背后的失败机制，识别出OPD更新无法纠正师生失配的关键状态，并用学生在教师top-p集合上的概率质量对其进行刻画。
